convention: Absolute optical frequencies in Hz at zero applied field. The three shifts are 88Sr minus the fine-structure centre of gravity of 87Sr. Lifetimes in seconds, rates in inverse seconds. Two quoted independent uncertainty components are combined in quadrature.

red88.source: Ferrari et al., published total uncertainty of 10 kHz; https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.91.243002. Sansonetti and Nave, Table 2, list 5 kHz systematic and 5 kHz statistical; https://doi.org/10.1063/1.3449176

red_shift.source: Miyake et al., 88Sr-87Sr fine-structure centroid, 3P1 column (Table II in the preprint arXiv:1907.06746); https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevResearch.1.033113

quadrupole88.source: Absolute-frequency measurement of the 1S0-3P2 line; https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.02470

blue88.source: Lee et al., experimental preprint; https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.29056

blue_shift.source: Rice University thesis, Appendix B, table B.3, sign converted; https://ultracold.rice.edu/publications/thesis_main-20190909-1500.pdf

triplet_lifetime.source: Nicholson et al., 87Sr cascade fluorescence; https://doi.org/10.1038/ncomms7896
